findings.evidence: At line 126 the boundary case is discharged solely by `(hreal z hz h.symm).ge`, and lines 147/151 use only the resulting nonnegativity to separate it from the lower branch.
findings.fix: State the helper using `MapsTo f (Ω ∩ {z | 0 ≤ z.im}) {z | 0 ≤ z.im}` (or weaken `hreal` to boundary nonnegativity), and generalize `injOn_schwarzReflection_of_symmetric` accordingly; derive this condition from `hupper` and `hreal` in the later reflection-principle corollaries.
findings.issue: `im_schwarzReflection_nonneg` and `injOn_schwarzReflection_of_symmetric` (line 133) require `(f z).im = 0` on the axis, but their proofs use only `0 ≤ (f z).im`; this makes the standalone injectivity result stronger than necessary.

summary: The core injectivity API unnecessarily requires real-valued boundary data where only closed-upper-half-plane preservation is used.
